webNotes: New in 2.4.14: Summer joins the shared apartment — her own 3D avatar, built from her Tripo model and slimmed to her real build (5'5", 120 lbs, petite; face and hair untouched). She stands level with Aimmianna — 1.78 units, never bigger. She stands on the opposite side of Aimmianna from Autumn, walks with her when the floor is tapped, hugs and hearts with her on the warm poses, and waves hello (greet_04) when tapped. Her idle is a gentle procedural breathing hold, since her file has no idle clip. Her base wardrobe is in too: high-class goth emo princess — six gowns, shoes, makeup, hairstyles and hair dye, picked from Summer's Wardrobe in the hub. She lives in the shared side only, never in Tony's private Game Mode, never in private memories. The full beauty salon (nails, tan, sauna, salon rooms) is queued for a later wardrobe expansion. Patch (webBuild 255): both guest models now load from ~16 MB chunks (.part0..3) glued back together in the app, because the single 64 MB files cannot be pushed to the repo — same models, same look, just shipped in pieces. Everything from 2.4.13 still stands: Autumn's avatar, the dedication to Emmi on the front of the app, the five mood poses, two doors two keys, guest codes, the Her World menu, and Rule 1. New in 2.4.15: Summer's arms now hang relaxed at her sides when she idles — her file has no idle clip, so she used to stand in a T-pose with her arms out. Tony's own figure joins the shared apartment too, standing in front of Aimmianna on his newer Tripo model with all nine of its animations; his private Game Mode figure is unchanged. New in 2.4.16: fixed Summer's arms flapping — the relaxed-idle layer was multiplying its rotation onto her arm bones every frame, and with no idle clip in her file the mixer never rewrote the bones, so the rotation compounded into a spin. The layer now sets her arms from their stored bind pose each frame when she idles, and only multiplies onto the mixer's fresh output while a clip is playing or fading out, so her arms hang still at her sides, walk properly with the clip, and blend back without a snap. Tony's shared slot and Autumn are untouched.
